title: eulophia angornensis
intro: Eulophia angornensis, commonly known as the Angora orchid, is a species of orchid native to the tropical regions of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating fever, cough, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia angornensis are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties, which can help in relieving congestion and promoting the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
